description: Draft a new collection page. It is always a draft, seen only at its preview_url until publish_collection. kind is yc_batch (rule {batch: "Fall 2026"}), speedrun_cohort (rule {batch: "SR008"}), startups (rule {tags: [slug, ...], category?}, any of the tags, or {stage: "series_b", category?}, every round at that stage: one of pre_seed, seed, series_a, series_b, series_c, series_d, growth; tags and stage never go together) or category (rule {category: value}; every category already has one). Every page is served at /collections/{slug}; slug is the words people search for it by ("yc-fall-2026", "robotics-startups"), unique across collections. A startups or category page needs its own title, h1, lead and description; a batch or cohort may leave them blank for its template. {count}, {first} and {latest} fill in, and {batch} on a batch. target_query is the one search the page is written for, unique across collections. controls says what the page offers over its cards: search (true/false), filters (any of topic, investor, stage), sorts (one or more of newest, biggest, the page's own order first) and group (day or none); a key left out keeps its default ({"search":false,"filters":[],"sorts":["newest","biggest"],"group":"none"}). Curator only.

controls.description: What the page offers over its cards; a key left out keeps its default.

group.description: day groups the cards by the day each was logged.

description.description: The meta description, at most 160 characters.

batch.description: A YC batch ("Fall 2026") or a speedrun cohort ("SR008").

stage.description: One round stage, on a startups page built on a stage ("series_b" for Series B startups); sent without tags.

tags.description: Tag slugs from list_bookmark_tags; a bookmark carrying any of them is in.

slug.description: The page's address, /collections/{slug}: lowercase words joined by hyphens, as people search for it ("yc-fall-2026", "a16z-speedrun-sr008", "defense-tech-startups").

target_query.description: The one search this page is written for.
